reviews.title: Great GPU, Perfect Gift
reviews.comment: Great GPU! Arrived well packaged and exactly as described. Tested with several games and works perfectly. Looks like new. My son was very happy to get this as a Christmas gift.
reviews.author: Dima Minka

reviews.title: great budget GPU
reviews.comment: despite this being a used/refurbished GPU, this works alot better than my old GPU and can play more games now, however you should also get a GPU support bracket with it since this card is a bit heavy and could pull on the PCI-E port overtime
reviews.author: techstallion

reviews.title: Buyer Beware - Buy New Instead
reviews.comment: This card worked great for 3 months.  Just after the return window expired, I started experiencing crashes when doing photo AI that relied on the GPU for processing.  The card causes my Windows 11 PC with 64GB RAM to crash/hibernate mode repeatedly to the point where it is not usable.  Avoid this product unless you enjoy wasting $389 dollars (my purchase price)
reviews.author: SZ

reviews.title: Nice card for the money
reviews.comment: Card didnt work but it was still a good card by spec. Ended up going with 5070 because it was better .
